### CVE-2026-2974 — AliasVault App Backup aliasvault.xml backup
- Assigner: VulDB | Published: 2026-02-23 | Updated: 2026-02-23 | Max CVSS: 2.5
- CWE: CWE-530 Exposure of Backup File to an Unauthorized Control Sphere; CWE-285 Improper Authorization
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 2 LOW `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:H/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 2.5 LOW `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N/E:P/RL:O/RC:C`
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 2.5 LOW `CVSS:3.0/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N/E:P/RL:O/RC:C`
- CVSS 2.0 (cna): 1 None `AV:L/AC:H/Au:S/C:P/I:N/A:N/E:POC/RL:OF/RC:C`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

A vulnerability was identified in AliasVault App up to 0.25.3 on Android/iOS. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file shared_prefs/aliasvault.xml of the component Backup Handler. The manipulation of the argument accessToken/refreshToken/metadata/key_derivation_params/auth_methods leads to exposure of backup file to an unauthorized control sphere. An attack has to be approached locally. The attack is considered to have high complexity. It is stated that the exploitability is difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 0.26.0 is able to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 873ecc03f92238e162f98a068ad56069a922b4f6/0bd662320174d8265dfe3b05a04bc13efc960532. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component. The creator of the software explains: "Because of AliasVault's zero-knowledge encryption design, the tokens stored in aliasvault.xml are API session tokens that cannot decrypt the vault on their own: the master password is required for that. So while this isn't a direct vault compromise risk, there's no reason to include them in backups either."

Affected:
- n/a / AliasVault App: affected 0.25.0; affected 0.25.1; affected 0.25.2; affected 0.25.3; unaffected 0.26.0

Credits: nmaochea (VulDB User)

TickTick Android application (com.ticktick.task) 8.2.2.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its exported ShareReceiveActivity that allows a malicious local application to write files outside the intended attachment directory by supplying a crafted content:// URI with a traversal filename via ACTION_SEND intents. ### CVE-2026-26214 — Xiaomi Galaxy FDS Android SDK <= 3.0.8 TLS Hostname Verification Disabled Enables MITM
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-02-12 | Updated: 2026-07-14 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE-297 CWE-297 Improper Validation of Certificate with Host Mismatch
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Galaxy FDS Android SDK (XiaoMi/galaxy-fds-sdk-android) version 3.0.8 and prior disable TLS hostname verification when HTTPS is enabled (the default configuration). In GalaxyFDSClientImpl.createHttpClient(), the SDK configures Apache HttpClient with SSLSocketFactory.ALLOW_ALL_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER, which accepts any valid TLS certificate regardless of hostname mismatch. Because HTTPS is enabled by default in FDSClientConfiguration, all applications using the SDK with default settings are affected. This vulnerability allows a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept and modify SDK communications to Xiaomi FDS cloud storage endpoints, potentially exposing authentication credentials, file contents, and API responses. The XiaoMi/galaxy-fds-sdk-android open source project has reached end-of-life status.

**workarounds:** Remove line 134 (the ALLOW_ALL_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER assignment). The default SSLSocketFactory uses STRICT_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER, which is the correct secure behavior.

Affected:
- Xiaomi Technology Co., Ltd. / Galaxy FDS Android SDK: affected 0 <=3.0.8 (semver)

Credits: XavLimSG; VulnCheck

References:
- https://github.com/XavLimSG/Vulnerability-Research/blob/main/CVE-2026-26214/CVE-2026-26214.md [technical-description,exploit]

### CVE-2026-30495
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2026-05-07 | Updated: 2026-05-08 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-285 CWE-285 Improper Authorization
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

The Optoma CinemaX P2 projector (firmware TVOS-04.24.010.04.01, Android 8.0.0) exposes Android Debug Bridge (ADB) on TCP port 5555 over the network without requiring authentication. The device is configured with ro.adb.secure=0, which disables RSA key verification. Additionally, a functional su binary exists at /system/xbin/su that grants root privileges without authentication. An attacker on the same network can connect to the device via ADB, obtain a shell, and escalate to root privileges, gaining complete control of the device. This allows extraction of stored WiFi credentials, installation of persistent malware, and access to all device data.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- https://whitelabel.org/security/2026-02-01-smart-projector/

The Optoma CinemaX P2 projector (firmware TVOS-04.24.010.04.01, Android 8.0.0) exposes an HTTP API on TCP port 2345 that allows full unauthenticated remote control of the device. The API supports both reading configuration (74 endpoints) and writing/modifying settings including volume, mute, brightness, power, network protocols enable/disable (including TELNET), display modes, and other projector functions. Any device on the same network can control the projector without authentication.

### CVE-2026-32317 — Cryptomator for Android: Tampered vault configuration allows MITM attack on Hub API
- Assigner: GitHub_M | Published: 2026-03-20 | Updated: 2026-03-20 | Max CVSS: 7.6
- CWE: CWE-346 CWE-346: Origin Validation Error; CWE-354 CWE-354: Improper Validation of Integrity Check Value; CWE-451 CWE-451: User Interface (UI) Misrepresentation of Critical Information; CWE-923 CWE-923: Improper Restriction of Communication Channel to Intended Endpoints
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Cryptomator for Android offers multi-platform transparent client-side encryption for files in the cloud. Prior to version 1.12.3, an integrity check vulnerability allows an attacker tamper with the vault configuration file leading to a man-in-the-middle vulnerability in Hub key loading mechanism. Before this fix, the client trusted endpoints from the vault config without host authenticity checks, which could allow token exfiltration by mixing a legitimate auth endpoint with a malicious API endpoint. Impacted are users unlocking Hub-backed vaults with affected client versions in environments where an attacker can alter the vault.cryptomator file. This issue has been patched in version 1.12.3.

Affected:
- cryptomator / android: affected < 1.12.3

References:
- https://github.com/cryptomator/android/security/advisories/GHSA-876q-q3mm-fcvj [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
- https://github.com/cryptomator/android/releases/tag/1.12.3 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2026-33976 — Notesnook vulnerable to RCE via stored XSS in Web Clipper rendering
- Assigner: GitHub_M | Published: 2026-03-27 | Updated: 2026-04-03 | Max CVSS: 9.7
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting'); CWE-94 CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.7 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Notesnook is a note-taking app. Prior to version 3.3.11 on Web/Desktop and 3.3.17 on Android/iOS, a stored XSS in the Web Clipper rendering flow can be escalated to remote code execution in the desktop app. The root cause is that the clipper preserves attacker-controlled attributes from the source page’s root element and stores them inside web-clip HTML. When the clip is later opened, Notesnook renders that HTML into a same-origin, unsandboxed iframe using `contentDocument.write(...)`. Event-handler attributes such as `onload`, `onclick`, or `onmouseover` execute in the Notesnook origin. In the desktop app, this becomes RCE because Electron is configured with `nodeIntegration: true` and `contextIsolation: false`. Version 3.3.11 Web/Desktop and 3.3.17 on Android/iOS patch the issue.

Affected:
- streetwriters / Notesnook Web/Desktop: affected < 3.3.11
- streetwriters / Notesnook iOS/Android: affected < 3.3.17

References:
- https://github.com/streetwriters/notesnook/security/advisories/GHSA-f42f-phvp-43x5 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2026-58924
- Assigner: google_android | Published: 2026-11-02 | Updated: 2026-11-06 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: Information disclosure; CWE-125 CWE-125 Out-of-bounds Read
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The vulnerability is a heap out-of-bounds read in the EVS HAL's `getStreamList()` method. An attacker can craft a `CameraDesc.metadata` byte array, which is parsed without validation, leading to an out-of-bounds read at an attacker-controlled offset within the HAL process's heap. The read data is then exfiltrated back to the attacker, potentially leaking sensitive information like pointers and buffer handles.

- Assigner: google_android | Published: 2026-11-02 | Updated: 2026-11-06 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: Elevation of privilege; CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

The report details a heap Use-After-Free (UAF) vulnerability within the `android.hardware.automotive.evs-default` HAL service, stemming from unsynchronized access to an `std::unordered_map`. An unprivileged application with access to the EVS manager can trigger this UAF by making concurrent calls to `setExtendedInfo` and `getExtendedInfo`, potentially enabling code execution within the privileged HAL process.

- Assigner: google_android | Published: 2026-11-02 | Updated: 2026-11-06 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: Elevation of privilege; CWE-451 CWE-451 User Interface (UI) Misrepresentation of Critical Information
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An unprivileged application can exploit a lack of package/signature validation in SystemUI's `RemoteQCController` when resolving a hardcoded `content://` URI. This allows the attacker to squat on a specific authority if the legitimate package is absent, inject spoofed UI elements into the trusted SystemUI Quick Controls panel, and gain a Background Activity Launch (BAL) grant from SystemUI when the user interacts with the spoofed element.

### CVE-2026-89038 — Verizon Cloud for Android < 26.7.10 Path Traversal via OneTouchUploadActivity
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-09-17 | Updated: 2026-09-17 | Max CVSS: 6.9
- CWE: CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 6.9 MEDIUM `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 6.2 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Verizon Cloud for Android (com.vcast.mediamanager) before 26.7.10 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows co-resident malicious applications to write attacker-controlled bytes outside the intended staging directory by supplying a crafted _display_name value containing path-traversal sequences through exported activities OneTouchUploadActivity and PrintShopCloudActivity. Attackers can exploit the unsanitized filename concatenation in the file-staging sink via ACTION_SEND or ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE intents to achieve arbitrary file write and inject attacker-controlled content into the authenticated user's Verizon Cloud account without user interaction.

Affected:
- Verizon / Verizon Cloud for Android: affected 0 <26.7.10 (semver)

Credits: Edward "Actuator" Warren; VulnCheck

### CVE-2026-103922 — Capacitor Android and iOS: remote content can be loaded at the app origin via the internal HTTP proxy path
- Assigner: GitHub_M | Published: 2026-10-01 | Updated: 2026-10-01 | Max CVSS: 9.3
- CWE: CWE-346 CWE-346: Origin Validation Error; CWE-441 CWE-441: Unintended Proxy or Intermediary ('Confused Deputy')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.3 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Capacitor is a cross-platform native runtime for web applications. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.2, 7.6.9, 8.3.5, 8.4.3, and 8.5.1, the Android and iOS WebView navigation guard validates a target URL's host and scheme but not its path, allowing a victim who activates an untrusted link to navigate a frame to /_capacitor_http_interceptor_. The native proxy can fetch an attacker-selected URL and return the response as a document at the application's own origin, allowing script in that response to access same-origin storage, cookies, and registered Capacitor plugin capabilities. Applications remain affected when CapacitorHttp is disabled because affected releases serve the proxy path regardless of that setting. This issue is fixed in versions 6.2.2, 7.6.9, 8.3.5, 8.4.3, and 8.5.1.

Affected:
- ionic-team / capacitor: affected >= 6.0.0, < 6.2.2; affected >= 7.0.0, < 7.6.9; affected >= 8.0.0, < 8.3.5; affected >= 8.3.5, < 8.4.3; affected >= 8.5.0, < 8.5.1
- @capacitor / android: affected >= 8.5.0, < 8.5.1; affected >= 8.3.5, < 8.4.3; affected >= 8.0.0, < 8.3.5; affected >= 7.0.0, < 7.6.9; affected >= 6.0.0, < 6.2.2
- @capacitor / ios: affected >= 8.5.0, < 8.5.1; affected >= 8.3.5, < 8.4.3; affected >= 8.0.0, < 8.3.5; affected >= 7.0.0, < 7.6.9; affected >= 6.0.0, < 6.2.2
- com.capacitorjs / core: affected >= 8.5.0, < 8.5.1; affected >= 8.3.5, < 8.4.3; affected >= 8.0.0, < 8.3.5; affected >= 7.0.0, < 7.6.9; affected >= 6.0.0, < 6.2.2
- swift / github.com/ionic-team/capacitor-swift-pm: affected >= 8.5.0, < 8.5.1; affected >= 8.3.5, < 8.4.3; affected >= 8.0.0, < 8.3.5; affected >= 7.0.0, < 7.6.9; affected >= 6.0.0, < 6.2.2
